completed: Spec blocker (S5): the geographic accessibility hard constraint is now reachable in the default path. It fails when the route reports a barrier or when the vacancy does not provide every entry in candidate.transport.accessibilityNeeds; the same accessibilityStatus feeds the transport dimension. The dangling RouteRequest.requiresAccessible was removed and SolverVacancy.accessibilityRequirements is documented as workplace-provided features.

Spec required (S7): ids are compared by UTF-16 code unit via compareCodePoints; no localeCompare remains in src.
